**Which file do I need?**

| Your device | Download |
|---|---|
| Android phone (almost all phones) | `Srot-android-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| Older or low-cost Android phone, if the one above will not install | `Srot-android-armeabi-v7a.apk` |
| Android, not sure | `Srot-android-universal.apk` (larger, works on every phone) |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `Srot-windows-x64.zip` |
| Mac with Apple chip (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `Srot-mac-arm64.zip` |
| Mac with Intel chip | `Srot-mac-x64.zip` |
| Chrome or Edge extension (for the Windows/Mac app) | `Srot-browser-extension.zip` |

Install steps for each one are in the README on the repository's front page.

**কোন ফাইল নামাবে?** Android ফোনে `Srot-android-arm64-v8a.apk`, Windows-এ `Srot-windows-x64.zip`, নতুন Mac-এ `Srot-mac-arm64.zip`। Install করার নিয়ম README-তে বাংলায় আছে।
